title: Unable to use a personnal Data privacy usage notice
body:
Hi

I am unable to use a personnal Data privacy usage notice.
Step to reproduce:
- in admin>options>security, I add a personnal Data privacy usage notice in the text area.
- in admin>options>plugin>comment_form, I add the field 'Data usage confirmation'
- in the front end, I went to comment_form, and then the texte remains with default value: 'By using this form you agree with the storage and handling of your data by this website.'

And btw, I don't understand why this 'Data privacy usage notice' field is not multilingual.

In the same way, I add a custom page url for Data privacy policy page and add a custom link text, but I don't have a link displayed in comment_form.

In the same way too, I don't understand why this 'custom link text' field is not multilingual.

Of course, the issue is the same with contact_form and register_user, so I think the issue is dealing with new options and functions for GDPR compliance.
author: Participant 1
